To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the MLE for the parameters in the class of Gibbs models is consistent if and only if the MLE is consistent for the hardcore parameters and the interaction range parameters, and that the MLE is always consistent for the hardcore and interaction range parameters.

(a) the strong consistency of the MLER holds for any Gibbs interaction with finite range, (b) the strong consistency holds for all parameters in the pairwise Strauss model, the pairwise hardcore Strauss model, and the Lennard Jones model, (c) the strong consistency for the area-interaction models holds for all parameters if the interaction range is finite, and (d) the consistency of the area-interaction MLE holds for all parameters, if the interaction range tends to infinity.
the maximum likelihood estimator is strongly consistent for the parameters of all parametric Gibbs point processes, including all parameters of all the above-mentioned models.
